title: Deutsche Inschriften Online (DIO)
institution: Die Deutschen Inschriften (Akademienunion; academies of Mainz, Göttingen, Düsseldorf, Heidelberg, Leipzig, Munich), with Epigraf (Digitale Akademie, Mainz)
license_note: Data dumps: CC BY 4.0 'where possible' (every article of the CGIF dump carries cc:by/4.0 as licence); images have their own, more restricted copyright. The portal itself shows a two-year moving wall after print publication.
notes: Edition of the printed series Die Deutschen Inschriften (Latin and German inscriptions up to 1650, some volumes later; whole database 31,197 articles dated 401-2022, of which 80 undated). texts = articles (catalogue entries, which can group several inscriptions) whose date span in the official CGIF dump (epigraf-public-cgif-001, 2025-09-14) overlaps 1450-1700: 26,678 (25,274 lie wholly within 1450-1700); our own count from the dump. Words not given: full transcriptions are published as EpiDoc only for DI 7 Braunschweig, DI 77 Greifswald and DI 102 Stralsund (978 articles); in those, 806 in-period articles hold 26,300 words (about 33 per article), which would extrapolate to roughly 0.9 million words for the whole, a rough estimate only. Other EpiDoc volumes are announced. The portal www.inschriften.net sits behind an Anubis bot check (returns a challenge page to curl), so its content was checked via the Epigraf dumps page, not the portal. Includes Austrian volumes of the Munich/Mainz series; the separate Viennese series (see oeaw-inschriften-wiener-reihe) is not part of it.
